reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I want to wholeheartedly thank and recommend Miami Animal Clinic, Dr. Palacios, and his entire wonderful team. They were there for Caramelito during a difficult time with his eye and treated him with so much love, patience, and dedication. For those of us who consider our pets part of the family, finding such an attentive and compassionate team means so much. Caramelito continues to recover, and we will always be grateful for all the help they gave us. Thank you for taking such good care of him! I recommend Miami Animal Clinic to all families looking for kind and dedicated care for their pets. May God always bless you!
Thank you,  Josefina for your  5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and are happy to care for you, and your pet.

Exceptional place to take your dog for major surgery or ongoing care. Dr. Palacios took my concerns seriously before my dog’s surgery and explained everything really well. I felt like I could leave my dog in trusted hands and know she would be taken care of. I was very nervous about her spay and mammary tumor removal, especially the anesthesia, but after speaking with the surgeon I felt much more at ease. My dog is recovering super well after such a major surgery. This veterinary clinic really takes your concerns seriously and is also mindful of cost while still making sure your dog gets the care they need. Even though this vet is a bit far from where I live, it’s worth the drive. I’ll definitely continue bringing my pets here!
Thank you so much Ashley, we truly appreciate your review.
Miami Animal Clinic are the best. Plus they treat our pets like if they were part of the family.

They are the best! We came all the way from Orlando, and just seeing the results, she knew what to do and acted immediately. My dog ​​is doing well, thank you, Doctor! We adore her and will continue traveling three and a half hours so that Toby can continue to be cared for by the best.

I’m so grateful for how helpful and compassionate this animal clinic was. Dr. Perez was amazing and very honest with me about the best options for my cat, who unfortunately broke her tibia and needs surgery. Since I’m not financially able to afford the surgery right now, she recommended a more affordable place where I can hopefully get her the care she needs.

She also gave me medication for my cat at no cost so she wouldn’t have to be in so much pain while I figure out the next steps. That meant so much to me, especially during such a stressful situation. I truly appreciate Dr. Perez’s kindness, honesty, and willingness to help. I’m incredibly grateful for the care and compassion she showed both me and my cat. ❤️
The Best Clinic In Miami, Dr. Perez" -- Dr. Lorente, and all the other doctors, the best care...the receptionists, Maria and all the others...very good prices...Good area, excellent service...

I am new to Miami and found this clinic by searching online and seeing their positive reviews, and I have to say, they certainly live up to their praise.  My cat needed medical care and the whole process was amazing from begining to end.  All the stuff are exceptional, but especially Carla at the front desk.  She had a kind smile and demostrated care and empathy, putting me at ease when I was anxious and things seened so dire, keeping me informed every step of the way.  The wait was minimal, the place is immaculate, they are bilingual, and treated my pet like royalty.  Dr. Palacios is who took good care of my cat and thanks to him, she is recovering well from surgery and in no more pain.  He personally spoke to me and provided me with all the feedback I needed to leave feeling at peace.   It is no wonder they have been voted twice, The Best in Florida, by Florida Guide, both in 2025 and 2026, because this team knows how to go above and beyond.  Thank you, I am truly grateful for this team!
The best doctors, nurses, and veterinary assistants ever! I highly recommend this amazing team. They are compassionate, professional, and truly care about their patients. ❤️🐾 …

After the x-ray showed two stones in my dog's bladder, I asked for an estimate for the removal surgery, and wow, $3850! I have to say they're super friendly, but to the point! I went to another clinic and, surprise, surprise, $1500 less than this place... it's outrageous! Kindness shouldn't cost so much. Have some respect for other people's wallets!
Thank you, for  trusting us with the care of your pets and  for taking the time to  review us. We greatly appreciate it.

5/5 Stars — Exceptional Care and Compassion!
I cannot express enough gratitude for the extraordinary care provided by the team at this veterinary clinic. From the moment you walk in, you can feel how much they genuinely care about every animal that comes through their doors.
A special recognition goes to Dr. Milady and Dr. Llorente. Both of them are outstanding, highly skilled, and compassionate professionals. They took the time to explain everything thoroughly, answered all my questions with complete patience, and provided top-tier medical attention. Their dedication, expertise, and warm bedside manner made a world of difference.
If you are looking for a clinic where your pets will be treated with world-class skill, empathy, and respect, look no further. I highly recommend Dr. Milady, Dr. Llorente, and the entire team to anyone seeking the best veterinary care possible!

I called about a community cat, and if you want to help, you can, not financially, and also because the cat isn't mine, but I think if we want to help a cat that can't be caught, and we're all Cuban, we can help even with a photo. We don't have to be so strict because we all come from the same place.

I had an emergency because my adopted dog's teeth were in very bad shape. I found this veterinary clinic because of its good reviews, and I wasn't wrong. The treatment from everyone, from the reception staff to the veterinarian, exceeded my expectations. They were very empathetic to my pet's situation, and I really appreciate that. Marco, as my pet is called, had to have 19 teeth extracted, and although it was something I didn't expect, the care I received—and I can tell it was the same for him—is evident in the fact that today he's a healthy, pain-free dog. Thank you are all I can say!
Thank you so much for your kind review, we truly appreciate  your trust in our team.

I had a wonderful experience at Miami Animal Clinic! From the moment I walked in, everyone was kind, welcoming, and genuinely caring. I especially want to recognize Carla at the front desk—she was incredibly friendly, helpful, and patient. She made the check-in process so easy and made me feel comfortable right away.

The entire staff was professional, compassionate, and attentive, and it was clear that they truly care about their patients and the people who bring them in. I really appreciate the time and care they provided and would definitely recommend Miami Animal Clinic to anyone looking for a trustworthy and caring veterinary clinic. Thank you, Carla, and the entire team, for such a great experience!
They are the best. Incredible doctors always offering you the time you need with no rush.

Dr. Lorente is an exceptional veterinarian who truly cares about his patients and their families. He’s been there for my dog through thick and thin, and the difference he’s made is remarkable. His calm demeanor and thorough approach immediately put us at ease. He takes the time to explain everything clearly, never rushed, always patient. The staff at the clinic is warm and professional, and you can tell they share the same dedication. We feel genuinely cared for, and we’re so grateful to have found him.

We love Miami Animal Clinic. Our family has two dogs that we take there routinely. The location is not close to us but the drive is worth it. Their staff is very kind especially Carla at the front desk. She is warm, caring & treats everyone like family. The vet is also very knowledgeable & we trust them with our pet’s care over any other vet we have seen in the past. The prices are fair & there is never a very long wait time. Highly recommend!

If I could give 0 stars, I would. Our dog seemed sick, so we took her in. Seemed to be the most well reviewed place by a mile. After blood work, they started saying she needs fluids and maybe has kidney disease. We were distraught! Our dog was 3.5 years old at the time. They said we need another test, but put her on a new diet immediately. We waited in agony for weeks to get the results back, which said everything is fine, but we were supposed to stay on the diet. We were relieved! $2000+ was a lot, but seemed like it had to be done. Later we got a new puppy, and brought him in when he had a bloody stool. Again, talks of fluids, overnight stay, and kidney disease. We were very confused. This time about $1000 as a "discount" for our other dog. There were gonna be several follow up visits. Later on we reconnected with our fort Lauderdale vet due to our confusion, Gentle Care (amazing btw), and they said our female dog was fine and there was no reason for them to have done all that and charged us based on the blood work. Gentle Care didn't even charge us for that visit, maybe because they felt bad for us. Essentially, it felt like we had gotten scammed by MAC. We now have an immense distrust for vets given this one's great reviews. It's a bit far, but seems like Gentle Care is our only option.
So grateful for my experience! They answered the phone on the first ring and were able to fit in our pup within the hour despite it being the end of the day. Very clean and staff was great.
Thank you so much for your review, it means so much to our entire team to know that you and your pet felt welcome.

We just left this clinic after our cat was showing signs of an infection and having come before this visit, we had very high expectations of the care our cat would receive and not only did they meet the expectations but they exceeded them. Having to come twice within 24 hours is never easy for anyone, especially if it’s for a family member who can’t speak or tell you what is going on with them, but on both occasions the doctor and vet techs were exceptional. We would love to shine a light on the vet tech we had this evening, she was the textbook definition of empathetic, patient, and caring; we felt so at ease immediately when discuss the health of our pet, it’s just something you simply cannot put a price tag on. The doctor as well, was exceptionally consistent, remembering exactly who we were and what problems presented yesterday and continued care with the goal of moving forward the treatment for our family.

Thank you so much for being an amazing clinic, the compassion they show is like no other, and in a city as big as Miami, this is a diamond location.

100/10 please come to this clinic if you love your animal.

They certainly do.

Just left this clinic as a first time visitor for my cat, it’s one of her first visits to a vet, i took her once to a petsmart veterinary and had the worse experience and ended up paying over +$200 at that vet.

now let’s talk about this gem, the assistants are so nice, the front desk is a slew of the nicest ladies that you can tell will care about YOU and YOUR PET. i was a walk in for today and although the wait was a bit longer than i’d hope, i was able to see many many patients come and go, and every. single. one. had such a positive greeting for everyone in the building. they exchanged hugs, talked families, and asked about the pets, and i don’t know about you, but when my pet is my literal child; seeing this before seeing the doctor was so unbelievably nice.

The doctor and the assistant? top-tier. assistant came in, did first assessments and was very calm and patient. the doctor came in after, saw the cat, was able to determine what course of action we would take and moved us along, all in maybe 30 mins total. so the wait was in waiting to go in, once you’re in; it’s super quick until you’re out, since this is a 10/10 for me.

now the pricing, this is the meat and potatoes here; i do not have insurance, i did not mention insurance, and was charged only $45 for the office visit!!! in miami that is RIDICULOUSLY CHEAP and for GREAT SERVICE, like please come here, i feel great leaving the vet, and i am looking forward to my next visit, honestly. i will bring my cat and my future cat(s) here for sure.

thank you.

i would post the medical bill in its entirety but it’s private info, however they are reasonably priced and NOT trying to upsell you on garbage.

I took my daughter’s cat Mao because he was not able to pee in his own, Dr. Perez took her time to explain what his condition was, took good care of him and Karla (front desk) was sweet and so helpful, even Carlos (assistant) was very attentive. Thank you Dr. Perez. (Segui Family)
My experience at that place has always been wonderful; they are professional, loving, and concerned about the well-being of pets.
We love it here, friendly staff, doctor is very nice, when you call to request records they are sent right away.
Thank you
Dr. Lorente was very professional and attentive to his patients; everyone was very good.

For me, the best veterinary clinic in the county.

Thank you Mileydis, thank you team...
Blessings to all.

Before you make a decision on where to take your pet, please give this clinic a chance. The staff at the front desk will be how you start experiencing the phenomenal customer service at this location. They are busy but not understaffed, they treat you like family, they take the time to help you. Then come the doctors. Our doc was Dr. Palacios. He is knowlegeable, attentive, communicates well, and understands the delicate balance between cost and care.
I strongly recommend you give this animal clinic a try, their customer service is exceptional, and their prices are reasonable.

I'm going to tell you Jacob's story!
Jacob is the little one in the house, a mischievous little dog who last Friday tried to escape by digging into the neighbor's yard because there was a rowdy female dog on the other side. His escape almost cost him his life because he injured his back very deeply (a horrible wound 🥺). When we found him, he was bleeding profusely from the wound. We called a friend who recommended Miami Animal Clinic. From the moment we arrived, we felt the love and professionalism of the staff. They gave him a complete checkup, and then he had to have surgery 🥺. Thank God the surgery was a success 🙏🏻. He was there until Monday receiving the necessary care and medication. Thanks to Dr. Lorente, Dr. Jorge, and the entire team, Jacob is now recovering. They gave him his life back! Five stars aren't enough because you deserve a whole starry sky. Jacob and his family are so incredibly grateful. 🙏🏻 God bless you. 🙏🏻

I came here after searching online, having wasted a lot of money with several vets. Here you can find true love for your pets 🥰 Thank you so much for your attention and for healing my Gina so quickly!!! …
Thank you
Thank you

A very professional veterinary clinic, especially Dr. Perales, who is very attentive to pet owners and their pets. I've seen how he treats other pet owners and their pets while waiting for my appointment. Everyone at the clinic is very professional. I highly recommend this clinic.
Excellent service and attention like no other. We wouldn't trade them for any other. Thank you always.
Thank you

Lucy received excellent service. On Memorial Day I was looking for a clinic that was open. I called a veterinarian friend to ask for recommendation, and he told me that he works there and they were open until 9:00 PM.

To my surprise, the clinic is owned by Dr. Mileydi Perez—who used to be my dogs' veterinarian in the past—though I had lost her contact information after she sold her previous practice.

Dr. Roberto Lorente attended to my dog ​​and performed a thorough examination. The clinic is equipped with modern technology and operates in a highly professional environment; and although the diagnosis is not very encouraging, I am extremely pleased with the care provided.

I recommend them without hesitation.
Everyone here is fantastic. Always kind and courteous.  I have known Dr. Miledys Perez for over 25 years.  She is caring and extremely knowledgeable.  Highly recommend...
Thank you

Today, Wednesday, May 20th, I am and will always be infinitely grateful for the attention and empathy of Dr. Palacio. He is very attentive, caring, and considerate. He saved Celina, a noble and affectionate little cat who came to stay with us about two and a half months ago. The receptionists and all the staff are very attentive. We are very happy. We went to see her after the surgery, and she is recovering well. Everything is very organized and clean. Thank you, thank you, Dr. Palacio. God bless you even more.
It was my first time and I was delighted. The service was excellent and the hygiene was impeccable. I highly recommend it.
Excellent customer service

Truly amazing experience, ivy and Mari were very comforting and hospitable. Leo and Dr. Lorente were truly angels, and a big thank you to the technicians Adrian and Mario! Everyone here genuinely cares about your furry bestie and wants to help you take care of them!!! They are honest and trustworthy! ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️ Clean and organized! Feels like a family in here.

Highly recommend!!

Super amazing! I looked at various clinics for my cat Ash and this one was the best regarding quality care  and pricing for procedures. Very grateful to Dr. Lorente and his technicians Leo, Adrian and Mario!

If you want your pet to be cared for by professionals who studied out of love for animals, who put their animals before money, if you want your pet to receive the best care, I will recommend this clinic without hesitation. My dog ​​had emergency surgery there and was admitted. He had problems after being discharged, not because of the surgery itself. As soon as we arrived, they attended to us. Everyone, from the receptionist to the cleaning lady, was an excellent professional. Thank you, Zeus's mom and dad.
Excellent service from the clinic, especially from Dr. Roberto and his assistant Marcos. Their advice and the way they treated my dog ​​was spectacular.
Thank you

Thank you Dr Diaz  her assistant  Marcos Yani   and everybody at Clinic for assisting and having patience with my cat Survi you saved her from being sick excellent Surgery excellent and caring service you are my new Veterinarian office thank you Sincerely Barbara Wehbe

My experience at Miami Animal Clinic was excellent. From the moment you arrive, the staff greets you warmly. The veterinarians are very professional and attentive, explaining everything clearly and treating the animals with great care.

The clinic is very clean and organized, and the service is quick and efficient. I highly recommend this clinic if you're looking for a reliable place with top-notch service.

Thank you, thank you, thank you for saving my dog ​​Nahla's life. A super humane and professional team. Thank you, Dr. Palacios, and all the technicians and front desk staff. A highly recommended veterinary clinic.

The service deserves 5 stars, but I'll give it 4 because of the prices. All the staff are super friendly. Dr. Palacios provides excellent care and is very dedicated. I don't know the assistants' names, but overall, the service is very good. The clinic is very clean, so everything is fine there. The downside is the limited parking and the prices. I find it a bit absurd that a sterilization surgery for a patient with pyometra costs $6,500. It's too much, even though they offer many financing options, which is normal in this country, but $6,500 is excessive. In the end, I got the surgery through the county at a community clinic for $80. So keep that in mind if you're hesitant to pay that much. Otherwise, I'm sure you'll still receive wonderful care. Would I go back? Yes, of course, for other things. I really liked the service.

Miami Animal Clinic is truly the best! The entire staff is compassionate, knowledgeable, and genuinely cares about the well-being of your pets.

I've had the pleasure of working with Dr. Perez and Dr. Palacios, and I couldn't be more impressed. Their expertise, kindness, and dedication to their patients are exceptional.

From routine check-ups to more complex procedures, the care and attention my pets receive at Miami Animal Clinic is top-notch. The facility is clean, modern, and well-organized, making every visit a stress-free experience.

I highly recommend Miami Animal Clinic, Dr. Perez, and Dr. Palacios to anyone seeking exceptional veterinary care. You won't find a more caring and professional team anywhere else
The best veterinary services!
Without a doubt, the best veterinary clinic we've visited in Miami! The doctors are excellent; their professionalism and dedication are always evident. I'm so happy to be with them! 100% recommended!
Dr. Perez's clinic is the best in Miami, it's excellent and her staff is wonderful, especially Jessy and Becky 👍🏻 👍🏻 …

I just left the clinic and I'm so happy! They treated my pet, who's like my child, wonderfully. I'm so happy! The doctors are magnificent. Congratulations to Dr. Mileydis, who treated me, for the excellent work they do! 🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰 Thank you! …

I've known Dr. Perez for years; she's been treating my pets since she was in Hialeah. She's incredibly professional, a wonderful person, and very loving with pets. I highly recommend her services to everyone. She's the best doctor for our four-legged babies.

It is not a surprisel that Dra. Mileydi Perez' clinc has been recognized for being the best in Miami. Her personal care, the cuality of the services, the wonderful personalof the front desk, nurses and doctor. I am glad that l finnally landed  in the right vet.
Best clinic in Miami! Great doctors and staff. Super friendly and care about your pets. Also super affordable compared to other places. I did two neuters and dentals very easy process!
Thank you
I take my kitty to Miami Animal Clinic because the Doctors and staff are very kind and professional. I highly recommend them….
Excellent service ,the whole staff is amazing ,Dr perez and Dr Palacios i highly recommended this clinic 100% they also accepts walk in ,excellent price…

Great service. Saved two of my pets. Just be careful with cats and smalls dogs because people with big dogs that go there do not control them, and a Yorkie almost got killed due to another customer not handling her dog.

Vet is amazing, I owe them for saving my 13 year old cat.
Thank you

I am always grateful for the excellent care and professionalism that the doctors and the rest of the staff at Miami Animal Clinic provide to my Dino. We have been relying on them for years to take care of him! I recommend them 100%.
Great vet clinic, staff is fabulous

Iveth and all the reception staff! They're the best ♥️♥️♥️ They always help me, they're quick and efficient 💪🏽✨ but the best thing is the service they provide! Always happy, with great energy and amazing customer service ♥️ …

I love this place; I always come with my dog, whether it's for an emergency or annual check-up. They always have a great attitude and are willing to help. You can see they truly love animals. 🥰 Pongo and Denisse 🥰 …

Wonderful experience as usual. The doctor and staff are friendly and professional. All my questions are answered satisfactorily and my pets are always taken excellent care of. The prices are the most economical, the doctor works with you and do not order unnecessary tests. Absolutely love this place, the new facility is state of the arts!
Excellent and very professional service.

highly recommend Miami Animal Clinic. I’ve taken my dog to several vets over the years, and this is by far the best clinic I’ve ever experience!!! I recommend them 120%.

The staff truly treats you like family,!!! and their level of care is exceptional. My 13 year old dog, Lili, was very sick, and we received different diagnoses from other vets. Thankfully, Dr. Palacios was the only one who correctly identified what was going on and helped us when we needed it most.

If you love your dog as much as I do, don’t hesitate—this is the place to go. I’m beyond grateful for their care and dedication.

Thank you, thank you, thank you, Dr. Palacios. I truly don’t know how to repay you for everything you did for Lili. Your care, dedication, and compassion meant the world to me ❤️ and I will always be grateful❤️ I know Lili is 13 years old  but Dr. Palacios never gave up on her. He never immediately suggested putting her to sleep like some other vets 😫. Instead, he always encouraged to try different options and gave me and Lili hope, saying, “let’s try this and see how she responds.” That compassion and dedication truly meant 🌍 to me!!! Also a special thank you to Maria during Lili hospital stay of 7 to 9 days, she sent me pictures every night so I could see how Lily was doing❤️😘 Also, thank you, Alexis, for everything you did as well.
Excellent service. They helped my cat Lulu quickly and professionally. Many thanks to the entire team at Miami Animal Clinic.

A very good experience at this clinic. The service was quick, friendly, and reasonably priced. You can tell how much care they have for the animals. I left feeling relaxed and satisfied. Highly recommended 💯🐾
They are the best if you want your pet in the best hands—humane people who help you at all times. I travel all over Miami to bring her here, but it's worth it.
This is the place ever I recommend them always! Suzie my cat is doing great thanks to them! They saved her thank God!

The experience at the clinic was phenomenal. The organization, cleanliness, order, and excellent service are all part of the atmosphere at Miami Animal Clinic. Not to mention the outstanding quality of the staff; their professionalism and unconditional love for our pets is their motto. I love this clinic and 100% recommend it.
Amazing vet 10/10 very helpful
Thanks to the entire clinic team, they are super professional, the place is super clean, the waiting times are short, and the results are the best. My dog ​​and I are very grateful.

Thank you always, Dr. Palacio, for your support and guidance regarding my pet's illness.
You are a very professional team and the best veterinary clinic in Miami, with excellent hygiene and affordable prices for everyone.

Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. 🙏

Excellent service! Dr. Palacios solved my dog's (Crica) big problem. She feels much better now. Ale's dental cleaning was fantastic. They are very professional and I highly recommend them. The quality of service, procedures, and staff attention is excellent.

I took my 13-year-old dog to this clinic and I was truly delighted with the service. From the moment we arrived, the staff was incredibly friendly and professional, and it's clear they genuinely care about the animals' well-being.

She had a dental procedure, and the whole process was quick, organized, and seamless. They explained each step to me and gave me a lot of confidence. My dog ​​left feeling calm and well cared for, which means everything to me.

I definitely recommend this clinic 100%, especially if you have older pets and are looking for a place where they'll be treated with care and affection.

I can honestly say this is the best clinic you can take your pet to. Dr. Perez and her team go above and beyond in every way. They are not only highly skilled but also incredibly kind and compassionate. They treat your pet like family and take the time to make sure you feel confident and informed every step of the way. It’s rare to find a place where you feel this level of trust and care. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone who truly wants the best for their pet.
The best place in Miami, an unparalleled staff. I've been taking my pets there for many years and I'm so grateful to the doctors and their staff. I love them and my dogs do too 🥰
The service was AMAZING! Can’t be more thankful to the entire team!
Great services the best in miami..

My family and I are so grateful to Miami Animal Clinic. Dr. Palacios, Dr. Perez, and the staff are truly outstanding. We travel all the way from Broward County because of the trust we have in the doctor.
Dr. Palacios has saved my dogs, time and time again. He is an angel with a beautiful soul and blessed hands. I have never encountered such a dedicated and talented veterinarian like him. The staff is also great. They are welcoming, warm, and treat our dogs with the outmost love. Truly there is no comparison. We highly recommend Miami Animal Clinic. Every pet owner deserves the peace of mind to have this level of care for their precious babies.

Let's start with Dr. Palacios, who is very knowledgeable. All the staff are very efficient, and the wait time isn't too long for the procedures they perform. I was extremely satisfied with the service, including the dental procedure done by Ale. If you want personalized attention and for your furry babies to be well cared for, this is the place. 100/10

Excellent service Dr palacios and all his staff are amazing with the animals, very professional, my dog Zeus is a very nervous and doesn’t like going to any vet, with them they  have a lot of patience with him. I will not take my dog or any of my animals to any other clinic,

My experience at this veterinary clinic was very disappointing. The organization is truly poor: wait times are long, communication is confusing, and there seems to be no coordination among the staff.

The most concerning aspect was how they handle medical decisions. I felt constant pressure to agree to expensive procedures without a clear or sufficient explanation of their necessity. The prices are excessively high compared to other places, and instead of offering options or alternatives, they resort to creating urgency and anxiety.

I also felt that they play on the emotional attachment one has to their pet, which I find unethical. In moments of vulnerability, the last thing one needs is to feel manipulated or pressured.

Overall, I would not recommend this clinic. I believe that the well-being of pets and the peace of mind of their owners should be the priority, and unfortunately, I didn't feel that way here.
Great service super professional and clean also the cat boss show up to say hi to my dog, doctor miledy was awesome!! Thanks
Thank you

I am so grateful for the service; they are excellent. The kindness and love they showed my cat Coco, who almost died, was immense. Thanks to Dr. Lorente, Leo, and their team, she recovered. If you want a veterinarian who treats animals with dedication and love, don't hesitate to come here. Plus, the prices are very affordable. Thank you so much!
The best services ..my pet feel much better
Very unprofessional and disorganized. I got quoted 5000 dollars for my dogs surgery and I went to another vet and they told me 1200. This place is a red flag beware

They are simply the best! I have a rescue and have several dogs that I take through out the year. They’re kind with both our pets and with us. Thank you so much Dra Milady y Dr Palacios son los mejores! And the staff is super friendly . Gracias Gracias .

If there were more stars I could give to each review, I would, because for me, 5 stars aren't enough. This is the best veterinary clinic I've ever been to. Starting with the veterinarians who work there and who, every day, make the greatest effort to care for each animal with all the love that can be given when you truly love what you do. Thanks to Dr. Lorente, who introduced me to this clinic, but above all, thank you for being there when we need you most.

I had a great experience at Miami Animal Clinic and can’t recommend them enough. From the moment I walked in, the staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming, which immediately put both me and my pet at ease. You can tell they genuinely care about the animals they see and the people who bring them in.

Dr. Palacio was especially wonderful—and professional. He took the time to answer all my questions and made sure I fully understood my pet’s care plan, which I really appreciated.

The male staffs were professional and made my dog feel comfortable to proceed to take some blood work and put my dog vaccines.

I also want to give a special shoutout to the receptionist in the red scrubs. She was so kind, patient, and helpful throughout the entire visit. Her positive attitude really stood out and made the whole experience even better.

Overall, highly recommend Miami Animal Clinic to anyone looking for a compassionate and knowledgeable veterinary team.

I can only say that this is the best place for your pets. The doctor, besides being very professional, won't charge you for procedures she doesn't perform. In other words, she takes care of your pet and your wallet. I spent years paying money elsewhere for things they didn't need. I am more than grateful to the doctor and all the staff. God bless them all.
The doctor and staff are amazing here, we brought our cat here yesterday and he is already doing so much better. Thank you to the amazing doctors here and staff, definitely recommend!
They don't provide proper customer service when you call, parking is difficult, and their hours are inconvenient for working people.
Great care.  Great staff
Excellent, I recommend it.
Very friendly and helpful. They help stray cats very compassionate . everyone there truly cares about animals . recommend 💯. …
Great servicio..the staff is the best .thank you

My chewy is so well loved here! 10/10 recommend this place! The staff is kind, the appointment was fast, no wait on my walk in visit. Great price in an a new and updated clinic. Miami is lucky to have this place, a veterinarian gem.
Excellent place! The staff is very professional and treats the animals with great care and professionalism. I highly recommend it.

I never leave reviews, but I felt like | had to after this experience. I came in already stressed about my pet, and instead of feeling reassured, l left feeling worse.

I am deeply grateful to Miami Animal Clinic and all the staff who work there. They saved the life of my little puppy, Carmela. We went in on a Thursday at 7 p.m. after I noticed blood in her stool and a sudden drop in her energy. Dr. Lorente saw her right away, and from the very beginning he was incredibly kind and gentle with her. They performed a fecal test and a parvo test, and unfortunately Carmela tested positive for Parvo.

Dr. Lorente was always honest and compassionate. He explained the seriousness of the illness and let us know from the start that there was only about a 50% chance of survival due to the severity of the virus. Even so, the entire team gave us hope and constant support. They allowed us to visit Carmela every day, which gave us peace of mind knowing she was in a safe, caring environment.

Don Leo and Don Mario are truly amazing people who treat every animal with love and patience. They were kind to us every single day and never made us feel rushed during our visits. Carmela was hospitalized for five days and was discharged with all the medications she needed to continue her treatment at home.

Because Parvo weakens the immune system, Carmela later developed kennel cough. I called the clinic, and they helped us on Christmas Day. They examined her, provided the necessary medication, and let her go home with us again.
